description: EDIT an existing TikTok ad in place — its ad text, call-to-action, landing URL, URL parameters (UTMs), name, video and cover, carousel sound or Instant Form — instead of deleting and rebuilding it, which throws away its review history and delivery learning. Only the fields you pass change. TikTok blanks any field a full update leaves out, so Hermoso rebuilds the edit from TikTok’s own stored copy of the ad and lays your changes over it; a text/name/media-only edit uses TikTok’s incremental mode. An ad that is SWITCHED ON needs confirm:true, because the change reaches real viewers once TikTok accepts it (and TikTok reviews it again); a paused ad edits freely. A CTA change also clears a dynamic-CTA portfolio, which TikTok would otherwise show instead, and the reply says so. The result is READ BACK from TikTok field by field — relay `verified` and the note as given. Free.

adId.description: the ad to edit, from list_tiktok_ads_campaigns

adText.description: the copy people read, 1-100 characters, no emoji

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

callToAction.description: TikTok’s CTA value, e.g. LEARN_MORE, SHOP_NOW, SIGN_UP, DOWNLOAD

confirm.description: required when the ad is switched on

imageIds.description: image ids for the ad: the video's cover (coverImageId from upload_tiktok_ads_creative), or the slides for an image ad

name.description: the ad name in TikTok Ads Manager

pageId.description: Instant Form id for a lead ad (checked first)

utmParams.description: URL parameters TikTok appends to the landing URL, e.g. {"utm_source":"tiktok","utm_campaign":"__CAMPAIGN_NAME__"}; up to 14. Values may be TikTok macros: __CAMPAIGN_NAME__, __CAMPAIGN_ID__, __AID_NAME__, __AID__, __CID_NAME__, __CID__, __PLACEMENT__. Replaces the whole set.

videoId.description: swap the video (from upload_tiktok_ads_creative); pass its coverImageId as imageIds too

name: update_tiktok_ads_ad
title: Edit a TikTok ad
